title: The Most Powerful Computers You've Never Heard Of
summary: Veritasium traces analog computers from the Antikythera mechanism and Kelvin's tide-predicting machines to fire control and modern analog approaches. It explains how these machines computed continuously rather than digitally.
why: Recommended in threads on analog computing, photonic chips, AI hardware and tide prediction as an engaging history of Kelvin's machines.

quote.text: His video before this one[1] goes into detail on that, and it was incredible.
